name: @starknet-innovation/bramble-core
description: Bramble wallet core (Rust, wasm32) with TypeScript bindings generated by UniFFI

scripts.build:wasm: ubrn build wasm2 --config ubrn.config.yaml --release && node scripts/node-esm-imports.mjs
scripts.build:ts: tsc -p tsconfig.json && cp src/generated/bramble_core.wasm src/generated/bramble_core_bg.js dist/generated/
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:ts
